codeReview.summary: Clean, correct replacement of the flaky wall-clock timing assertion with overlap-based concurrency detection. The new logic records per-stage start/end execution windows via try/finally blocks and asserts that branch_a and branch_b overlapped (a.start < b.end AND b.start < a.end), which is the mathematically correct interval-overlap test. The report-ordering assertion now checks against branch end times rather than start times, which is strictly more correct. The elapsed-time threshold that caused CI flakiness has been fully removed. The worker ran the targeted test 5 consecutive times to confirm stability, ran flake8 lint, and documented the change in .factory/library/pipeline-upgrade.md.
